note.text: Remove obsolete host-isolation workarounds: audit flake.nix, flake inputs and outputs, development-shell environment variables, package-manager configuration, direnv integration, shell hooks, worktree bootstrap, scripts, and documentation for mechanisms whose purpose is to keep project tools, configuration, caches, state, or installs isolated from the developer's wider host system. Once the MicroVM provides that boundary, remove redundant mechanisms and simplify the repository accordingly. Do not remove Nix settings that remain necessary for reproducibility, dependency pinning, build correctness, supported workflows, or guest behavior merely because they also improve isolation. Document the audit and the reason each mechanism was removed or retained. Project-controlled Nix evaluation must still occur only inside the guest.
